data.name: TRAP LAB
data.detailed_description:
TRAP LAB looks like a friendly little platformer. It is not.

Every level is an experiment designed to betray you: floors that crumble the moment you trust them, spikes that wait until you're close, doors that were never really doors, and invisible bridges that only the brave discover. You will die. A lot. Every death teaches you the level's lies — and beating them anyway feels incredible.

FEATURES

  • 60 handcrafted levels across 11 worlds — plus vertical tower climbs, freefall descents, and a final boss battle
  • 12+ trap types: fake blocks, pop-up spikes, drop blocks, buzzsaws, turrets, ghosts, invisible platforms, and doors that lie
  • Grow stronger as you go: unlock DOUBLE JUMP, DASH, and three weapons (missile, shotgun, piercing rocket)
  • Mouse-aimed combat: swarms of walkers, flyers, leaping frogs, charging bulls and tanky brutes pour in from spawner doors
  • A multi-phase FINAL BOSS with bullet-hell patterns that get meaner as its health drops
  • Checkpoints everywhere. Instant respawns. Your rage is the only loading screen.

BEAT THE GAME, GET THE SEQUEL FREE

Finish TRAP LAB and you've earned it: every player who beats the final boss gets a FREE Steam key for TRAP LAB 2 — the merciless sequel built for champions. Proof of clear, key in hand. That's the deal.

FAIR WARNING

This game will trick you, taunt you, and take your dignity. But every trap can be read, every jump can be made, and every level has been verified beatable. When you finally win, you'll know you earned it.

data.short_description: A cute platformer that lies to you. Fight through 60 levels of fake floors, pop-up spikes, and traitorous doors — unlock double jumps, dashes and rockets, survive monster swarms, and take down the boss. Die. Learn. Rage. Repeat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
